concepts.def: 1907 alliance of Britain, France and Russia; countered Triple Alliance of Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy.
Diplomatic cascade after Sarajevo assassination; Austrian ultimatum to Serbia, mobilisations, declarations 28 July - 4 August.
Bolsheviks made peace with Germany surrendering Ukraine, Baltic states, Finland; Germany lost gains at Versailles.
Imposed reparations, territorial losses, military limits and war guilt (Article 231) on Germany; nullified by Hitler.
Stresemann-Briand agreement guaranteeing Franco-German borders; brought Germany into League of Nations 1926.
Hitler's 22 June invasion of USSR with 3.8 million troops; halted at Moscow December 1941.
